mercury.renderer: Full-screen WebGL signed-distance field, premultiplied alpha, scissored to the occupied region, DPR capped at 1.5, paused when hidden or settled.

behaviours: screen flood for the menu, parted by the pointer
mercury.gating: Not created under prefers-reduced-motion or without WebGL. Cursor runs only with (pointer: fine) and mouse/pen events; the flood runs on all devices with WebGL. Native cursor hidden only when html.has-fluid.
mercury.fallback: Flat Mercury Silver #c9ccd0 surface, circle clip-path reveal (instant under reduced motion).

accessibility: Contrast: sand 13.22:1, sand-2 8.27:1, sand-3 5.32:1, orange 6.33:1 on slate; slate ink 6.2:1 on mercury floor, 11.16:1 on mercury silver.
Focus: 1px orange outline, 6px offset; bracket links show brackets + orange instead.
Reduced motion: no Lenis, no fluid, no intro; hero not sticky; scrubbed drawings rendered finished; CSS transitions and animations 0.01ms.
Touch: hover effects gated by (hover: hover); grid halo off; mercury cursor off; flood menu kept.
Menu: role=dialog aria-modal, focus trap, Esc closes, focus returns to the toggle; header reappears on focusin.
Skip link to #main; decorative SVG/canvas aria-hidden; pending index titles carry an aria-label.

narrative.overview:
Every page is a sheet in a drawing set that is still being drafted. The sheet is slate, the linework and lettering are sand, and orange is the drafter's red pencil: it marks only what is measured, pointed at, or live right now. Scrolling does the drafting. It draws extension lines, counts dimensions up from zero, runs leaders out to notes and inks the name in the footer, so motion is the act of making the drawing and never ornament laid over it. The sheet keeps the conventions of a real one: a bordered frame with zone letters and numbers, registration crosses at the corners, a title block, a revision delta, a true-to-size scale bar, and dashed lines for anything not yet built.

Against that precise, flat, hairline world there is exactly one material with mass: a drop of liquid mercury that is the cursor. It trails, grows spikes toward anything clickable, crawls around a hovered control from the side you came in, splashes on click, and floods the whole screen to become the menu. Everything else stays paper-flat. Density is low: big expanded lettering, generous slate, and small mono data clustered at the edges where a drafter would put it. Headings are left-weighted and stepped rather than centred.
keyCharacteristics: Slate ground, sand line and letter, orange reserved for measurement, leaders and live state.
Line weight and line style carry meaning: hairline grid, 1px objects, dashed means not yet drawn.
Two type voices only: Archivo at expanded width for lettering, Geist Mono uppercase for every measurement and piece of sheet data.
Square everything: no radius anywhere in CSS.
Mercury is the only depth, the only gradient, the only organic shape.
Content-explaining motion is scrubbed by scroll; time-based motion is reserved for responses to input, the one-shot plotter intro, and the liquid itself.

rules.name: The Red Pencil Rule
rules.body: Orange means "measured, pointed at, or live". It marks dimensions, leaders, the active zone, the plotter, focus and hover, and nothing decorative. If it is not a line, a tick, a dot, a small square or a state change, it is not orange.

rules.name: The No Orange On Mercury Rule
rules.body: Orange fails on liquid metal (1.02:1). On the flood, every text colour is full slate ink, hover stays ink and the brackets carry the state; hierarchy on mercury comes from weight and line style, never from fading or colour.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Sand Tertiary (5.32:1) is the faintest text on slate. Rule Grey is for lines only.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: Archivo letters names and statements; Geist Mono writes measurements, codes and sheet data. A number that measures something is always mono and tabular; a heading is never mono.

rules.name: The Measured Truth Rule
rules.body: Every dimension shown is measured from the rendered type at runtime (CSS px to mm at 96 dpi, 25.4/96) and counts up from 0.0 as it is drawn. Annotations never show invented values; the lettering note states the real spec (Archivo, wdth 125, wght 640, track −0.025em).

rules.name: The One Material Rule
rules.body: Mercury is the only thing on the sheet with depth, gradient, reflection or curvature. Everything drawn on the sheet stays flat line and flat letter.

rules.name: The Line Weight Rule
rules.body: Weight and style are semantic. Hairline (canvas alpha 2.6% minor / 5.5% major) is the grid. 1px is every object, rule and outline. 1.25px is ticks and icons. 2px brackets exist only on mercury, where the medium is louder. Dashed (1px) means not yet built: pending titles, unfinished sheets, rows in drafting.

dos: **Do** keep orange to lines, ticks, dots, small squares and state changes (#ff6b2c), per The Red Pencil Rule.
**Do** set every measurement, code and field label in Geist Mono uppercase, 0.06em tracking, tabular numerals.
**Do** measure real values from the rendered page before showing them as dimensions, and count them up as they draw.
**Do** mark anything unbuilt with a 1px dashed line and say "In drafting" honestly instead of linking to nothing.
**Do** tie explanatory motion to scroll with scrub, and give every scrubbed drawing a finished static state (`progress(1)`) for reduced motion.
**Do** gate hover effects behind `(hover: hover)` and mirror each one on `:focus-visible`; the default focus ring is a 1px orange outline offset 6px.
**Do** run the mercury cursor only on fine pointers and hide the native cursor only when it is running; touch devices keep the flood menu and the native experience.
**Do** keep text on mercury in full slate ink at ≥6:1, using weight and dashed underline for hierarchy.
**Do** return the header whenever focus enters it, trap focus in the open menu, and close it on Esc.
donts: **Don't** put orange text, hover colour or accents on the mercury flood (1.02:1).
**Don't** add border radius, box shadows, gradients or glass to anything drawn on the sheet; mercury is the only material with depth.
**Don't** use Rule Grey (#4a4740) for text, or anything fainter than Sand Tertiary (#928b7c) for text on slate.
**Don't** use arrowheads on dimensions; use 45° architectural ticks.
**Don't** set headings in mono or measurements in Archivo.
**Don't** let any intro or animation hide content when it fails: gates must have a timeout and a reduced-motion bypass.
